Class TestHRegionConcurrency

java.lang.Object
org.apache.hadoop.hbase.regionserver.TestHRegionConcurrency
Direct Known Subclasses:
TestHRegionConcurrencyWithInMemoryFlush
@Tag("org.apache.hadoop.hbase.testclassification.VerySlowRegionServerTests") @Tag("org.apache.hadoop.hbase.testclassification.LargeTests") public class TestHRegionConcurrency extends Object
Concurrent region operations with regular and in-memory-compacting MemStores.

    • testFlushCacheWhileScanning

      @Test public void testFlushCacheWhileScanning() throws IOException, InterruptedException
      Flushes the cache in a thread while scanning. The tests verify that the scan is coherent - e.g. the returned results are always of the same or later update as the previous results. scan / compact thread join
      Throws:
      IOException
      InterruptedException

      @Test public void testWritesWhileScanning() throws IOException, InterruptedException

      InterruptedException
